asset_panel.extension_selection: additional high-activity USDT pairs with a complete four-year hourly history; selected before inspecting their null-decomposition outcomes

null_modes.sign: keep magnitude path; permute signs within strata
null_modes.magnitude: keep sign path; permute magnitudes within strata

method.null_limitation: sign and magnitude nulls do not preserve contemporaneous sign-magnitude pairing; they are attribution diagnostics, not structural order-book models
method.bootstrap_interpretation: uncertainty of observed weekly variance conditional on the empirical null median

posthoc_asset_extension.status: robustness panel; not part of the predeclared all-asset gate
